no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not referred for review to an advisory committee, because outside expertise was not necessary. There were no controversial issues that would benefit from advisory committee discussion.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for EMFLAZA (deflazacort, jointly reviewed under NDA208684/NDA208685). The Summary Review states the application was not referred to an advisory committee because outside expertise was not necessary and there were no controversial issues warranting discussion, and the Office Director memo and Cross-Discipline Team Leader review concur that no AC meeting was needed. Because no committee was held, there are no committee-driven linkages to labeling, REMS, or postmarketing requirements.
